agent_slug.description: the agent whose seat read the area; a primer is forked only by chairs of this agent

area.description: lowercase-hyphen area slug the primer covers

session_id.description: the priming chair's (gig_id, role) session uuid; a fork resumes it with --fork-session

files.description: every file the seat read (and, for a rolling primer, the forked primer's files), each with its git blob at seal; a changed blob is named to the fork as stale

context_tokens.description: input + cache_read + cache_creation of the seat's last usage before sealing; compared with fork_from.max_context_tokens

frontier.description: uuid of the last user line before the seat's first write-tool call (Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit); a fork resumes the primer's session cut there with --resume-session-at, so it loads what the seat read and never what it then did. Absent when the seat wrote nothing or no user line preceded its first write: the fork then resumes the whole session.
